title: Pork chop, barley and spring greens bowls

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Barley, pork chops, greens, apples, mustard, cider vinegar and honey are all plain foods a grandparent would have had to hand.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday item at Tesco or any mainstream supermarket.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a saucepan, a frying pan and a sieve, with simple simmering and frying.

works.reason: 250g barley, four chops and 300g greens make a sensible lunch for four, and the timings for the barley, chops and greens are sound.

honest_times.reason: Twenty minutes covers the chopping, dressing and frying, and 35 minutes cook time matches the 30-minute barley simmer plus resting.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used, and the steps add nothing unlisted apart from water.

seasonal_feel.reason: A warm barley bowl with fried spring greens suits late March, and the greens are a main component rather than a garnish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear and in plain British English.

hearty_healthy.reason: It is a balanced meal of wholegrain, lean protein, greens and fruit that a family would happily eat.
